item.description:
新增中英文支持

  • 应用界面支持简体中文和英文，默认跟随系统首选语言。
  • 菜单、设置、快捷键录制与冲突提示、权限说明和交互预览均提供双语文案。
  • 优化较长英文文案的按钮宽度与说明换行，并补充无障碍标签的翻译。

可在 macOS「语言与地区」设置中为 CursorMover 指定语言，退出并重新打开应用后生效。

Chinese and English Support

  • The app now supports Simplified Chinese and English, following your preferred system language by default.
  • Menus, settings, shortcut recording and conflict messages, permission descriptions, and interactive previews are localized.
  • Improved button widths and text wrapping for longer English labels, with translated accessibility labels.

Choose a language for CursorMover in macOS Language & Region settings, then quit and reopen the app to apply it.
